measured_artifact_binding.method: Read full local bytes with stat/mutation guards; compare SHA256 to remote LFS metadata and Git blob SHA1 to remote Git object IDs, plus file sizes. Never infer integrity from cached filenames.
measured_artifact_binding.documentation_policy: README/license/.gitattributes differ or may be absent in original model directories and are recorded separately; this card and its evidence are intentionally updated. Supporting PNGs and repair provenance are included in the match count.
measured_artifact_binding.historical_scope: This verifies current local/published artifact parity. Historical results retain their original recorded provenance; this audit does not retroactively prove identical artifacts for every historical measurement.

C84_statistics.quality_delta: after minus before; canonical two-stage paired item bootstrap
C84_statistics.ratio: after/before ratio of arithmetic means; canonical _paired_ratio
C84_statistics.decode: arithmetic mean of per-request rates, not total tokens/total time
C84_statistics.multiplicity: Intervals are nominal exploratory per-metric intervals, not familywise adjusted.

C84_limits: Five pairs per axis; zero discordance is not ±5pp equivalence.
No across-model or across-axis pooling and no composite quality ranking.
Prose quality requires paired human/source review, not equality hashes.
Short-request memory telemetry is not capacity evidence; assess separate matched capacity probes.
Combined latest source bundle (C85 lifetime/logical-trim repairs and upstream updates) plus native16-only session retirement; not an isolated bugfix, kernel or cache-policy effect.
Actual-stack combined-bundle comparison, not original C77 old/upstream-runtime comparison; no isolated source or retirement-policy attribution.
Time order is before then after; same-session matching does not isolate every temporal/system effect.

limits: One observation per state; no repeatability interval or isolated causal attribution.
Combined source bundle plus native16 retirement policy.
Rough48GB is not a hard selection gate; retrieval co-score is not quality certification.

acc.note: p_d = 0: not one item's outcome flipped, so the lever moved no graded outcome on this set. A powered test needs discordant pairs to exist.

paired_m36_pooled.notes: Equal weight per item across two fixed 50-item datasets. Paired bootstrap; pooled support does not erase dataset-specific effects. Descriptive intervals before campaign multiplicity adjustment.
